English Language Requirement Form for Exchange and Guest Students 
- this form must be signed by the student and the responsible person at the home university 
- to be enclosed to the application form to become an exchange or guest student 
A good standard of English is required to become an exchange student at the University of Southern 
Denmark as teaching typically involves student participation, class discussion, project work, and student 
presentations. This means that you must have a command of the English language equivalent of the IELTS 
score 6.5 or the TOEFL score 88. We ask you and your home university to document your English skills 
through this language requirement form which in words describes the required English level. 
To follow courses offered in English, your English skills must as a minimum compare to the below 
description: 
You must: 
• understand general and academic topics presented in English orally and in writing 
• master a varied vocabulary which enables you to participate in conversations and 
discussions in English 
• be able to account for contents and viewpoints in different types of English texts 
• articulate your viewpoints in English both orally and in writing 
• be able to give a detailed, coherent oral and written account of a known topic in fluent and primarily 
correct English 
To be signed by the student 
With my signature I confirm that I have the above described English skills
